consultation.name: Consultation
consultation.desc: General and follow-up consultations with our doctors, same-day appointments.

laboratory.name: Laboratory
laboratory.desc: Malaria, blood count, glucose, urinalysis, HIV and more — most results within the hour.

dental.name: Dental
dental.desc: Check-ups, fillings, extractions and cleaning by our dental officer.

ultrasound.name: Ultrasound
ultrasound.desc: Obstetric and abdominal scans, with a printed report for your doctor.

nursing.name: Nursing care
nursing.desc: Injections, dressings, vitals and short-stay observation beds.

surgery.name: Minor surgery
surgery.desc: Suturing, abscess drainage and small procedures under local anaesthesia.

circ.name: Circumcision
circ.desc: Safe, hygienic procedures for boys and men with follow-up visits included.

fp.name: Family planning
fp.desc: Confidential counselling and the full range of modern methods.

hiv.name: HIV testing & vaccination
hiv.desc: Rapid HIV testing with counselling, and routine child and adult vaccines.

landing.openNow: Open now · closes {{closes}} · current wait about {{wait}} min
landing.heroLead: A private polyclinic in Kiramuruzi, Gatsibo District, open 24 hours a day, seven days a week: consultation, laboratory, dental, ultrasound, nursing and family-planning services.
landing.ctaBook: Find a doctor & book a time

stats.hours: open every day, day and night

signin.title: Staff sign in
signin.sub: Clinic System · for clinic staff only
signin.staffIdHint: The ID the manager gave you. Next: username and PIN, then the code sent to your e-mail.
signin.notStaff: This staff ID is not known. Ask the clinic manager.
signin.checkFailed: Could not check the ID. Try again.
signin.note: Works offline on registered clinic devices. Access is logged.
signin.unknown: Unknown username. Sample accounts: j.uwimana, c.nyirahabimana, b.mukamana, s.mugisha, t.mugabo, f.ndayisaba.
signin.failed: Wrong username or PIN. Try again or ask the manager to reset your PIN.
signin.inactive: This account has been deactivated. Ask the clinic manager.

doctors.title: Find a doctor and see when they are free
doctors.lead: Every doctor's calendar is public for the next seven days, in every service category. Pick a free time and reception confirms it with you.
doctors.legend: Numbers are free slots that day ·

services.title: What we offer
services.lead: Nine service lines under one roof, so most visits are completed the same day. Sample prices shown; the receptionist confirms the price before your visit.

book.title: Book a visit in three steps
book.lead: Walk-ins are always welcome. Booking ahead shortens your wait and lets the doctor prepare your file.
book.step1: WhatsApp or SMS your name, the service you need and a preferred day and time — or call reception.
book.step2: Within the hour during opening times you receive a confirmation with your appointment time and doctor.
book.step3: Bring your national ID. You get a ticket number and the screen shows when it is your turn.
book.emergency: Not for emergencies. If someone is in danger call 912 (SAMU) or come straight to the clinic.
book.sent: Request sent. Reception will confirm by {{channel}} within the hour during opening times.
book.sentRef: Request {{ref}} sent. Reception will confirm by {{channel}} within the hour during opening times.
book.sendFailed: The request could not be sent. Check your connection or call reception.

insurance.title: Insurance we accept
insurance.lead: Bring your card and ID; we bill your insurer directly and you pay only your share at the cashier — cash, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, card or bank.
insurance.soonTitle: Insurance partnerships are on the way
insurance.soonLead: The clinic is not yet partnered with any insurer. For now, every visit is paid at the cashier — cash, MTN MoMo or Airtel Money. We will announce our insurance partners here as soon as agreements are signed.

visit.addressLine2: Kiramuruzi Sector, Gatsibo District, Eastern Province
visit.mapNote: Replace with an embedded map or a photo of the clinic entrance
visit.mapAria: Map of Muhazi Medical Clinic in Kiramuruzi, Gatsibo

footer.rights: © 2026 Muhazi Medical Clinic · Kiramuruzi, Gatsibo, Rwanda
footer.version: Clinic System v1.0 · Kinyarwanda · English · Français
footer.about: A private polyclinic in Kiramuruzi, Gatsibo District, open 24 hours a day, seven days a week: consultation, laboratory, dental, ultrasound, nursing, minor surgery, family planning, HIV testing and vaccination.
footer.emergency: Emergency? Call 912 (SAMU) or come straight to the clinic.
footer.law: Patient data is protected under Law 058/2021 on personal data protection and privacy.
footer.languages: We speak Kinyarwanda, English and French.

booking.title: Find a doctor and pick a time
booking.lead: Choose a service, then a doctor; free times are shown for the next seven days. Reception confirms every request by WhatsApp, SMS or a call.
booking.labTitle: Laboratory does not need an appointment.
booking.labBody: Walk in 07:00–19:00 with your doctor's request form or ask for a test at reception. Most results are ready within the hour.
booking.replyNote: Reception replies within the hour during opening times. Not for emergencies — call 912.
booking.sentBody: {{doctor}} · {{when}}. Reception will confirm by WhatsApp or SMS. Bring your national ID.
booking.sendFailed: The request could not be sent. Check your connection or call reception.

home.emptyQueueBody: Patients who arrive or take a walk-in ticket will appear here, ordered by triage colour.
home.quietBody: No appointments are due before 09:00. First booked patient: Uwase Claudine at 09:00.
home.noAppointmentsBody: Approved and confirmed bookings for today appear here. Walk-ins go straight to the queue.
home.inquiryRejectReason: Reason for rejecting this inquiry (the patient is told):
home.noResults: No results in the last two days.
home.noCalendar: No booked patient for you today.
home.declineReason: Reason for declining (the patient is told):
home.noOpenBills: No bill is waiting for payment.
home.quickNote: Buttons stay ≥44 px and keep 30% spare width for Kinyarwanda / French labels.
home.methodsHint: Accepted payments: cash, MTN MoMo and Airtel Money.

dashboard.subtitle: {{town}} · {{range}} · updated {{time}}
dashboard.queueNow: Queue now · waiting time per station
dashboard.noTreatments: No treatment charged in this period.
dashboard.catalogueNote: Prices, discount allowances and insurer coverage are managed on the Treatments & prices page.
dashboard.stockOk: Every item is above its reorder level.
dashboard.staffActivityNote: every record carries the employee who made it
dashboard.noLogins: No sign-in in the last 24 hours.
dashboard.revenueAria: Revenue per day for the last 30 days, latest {{latest}}
dashboard.backupLast: Last successful backup · {{size}} GB · off-site copy confirmed {{time}}

placeholder.title: {{screen}}
placeholder.body: This screen is not designed yet. It is specified in the project document and will be built in its phase.

staff.title: Employees
staff.lead: Every employee gets a staff ID, a username, a first PIN and an e-mail address. To sign in they type the staff ID on the public page, then username + PIN, then the code sent to their e-mail. They must change the PIN at first sign-in.
staff.noEmail: No e-mail yet — sign-in codes cannot be sent

emailCard.title: E-mail for {{name}}
emailCard.body: The six-digit sign-in code is sent to this address at every sign-in.

form.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore (3–32).
form.pinHint: Six digits. Generate one and hand it over in person.
form.emailHint: The sign-in code is sent here at every sign-in. Use an address only this employee reads.
form.usernameHint2: Suggested from the name but mixed (order, letters, a number), so it cannot be guessed. Press Suggest for another one, or type your own.
form.noDepartments: No departments yet: create them in the Departments tab, then place employees in them.

created.title: Account created — give these to {{name}} in person
created.note: The PIN is shown only once. The employee types the staff ID on the public page, then the username and this PIN, then the code sent to the e-mail. The PIN must be changed at first sign-in.

reset.title: Reset PIN for {{name}}
reset.body: A new six-digit PIN replaces the old one immediately. Hand it over in person; the employee must change it at first sign-in.

errors.pin: The PIN must be six digits.
errors.emailTaken: This e-mail is already used by another employee.
errors.roleDept: This role does not belong to that department. Choose another department, or add the role to it.
errors.needDept: Choose a department for a head or an assistant head.
errors.name: Enter the full name.

staff.lead2: Create and edit employee accounts, place each one in a department as head, assistant head or member, reset PINs and deactivate accounts. Every change is confirmed with a code sent to your e-mail.

confirm.title: Confirm with a code
confirm.hint: The code is checked on the server and the change is recorded in your name. It works once and expires after 10 minutes.
confirm.wrong: That code is wrong or has expired. Nothing was changed.
confirm.required: Type the code from your e-mail to save.
confirm.deactivate: Deactivate {{name}} (they can no longer sign in)
confirm.sending: Sending a code to your e-mail…
confirm.sentTo: We sent a code to {{to}}. Type it here to approve this change.
confirm.notSent: The code could not be sent. Try "Send again".
confirm.wait: A code was sent less than a minute ago. Wait a moment, then send again.

dept.lead: Create the clinic’s departments and say which roles belong to each. Employees are then placed in a department as head, assistant head or member; the head gets the department dashboard.
dept.confirmDelete_one: Delete "{{name}}"? Its {{count}} employee stays employed, without a department.
dept.confirmDelete_other: Delete "{{name}}"? Its {{count}} employees stay employed, without a department.
dept.name: Department name
dept.roles: Roles that belong to this department
dept.rolesHint: Only employees with these roles can be placed here. Tick none to allow every role.

login.title: Staff sign in
login.lead: Enter your username and PIN. We then send a six-digit code to your e-mail.
login.failed: Wrong username or PIN. Try again or ask the manager to reset your PIN.
login.inactive: This account has been deactivated. Ask the clinic manager.
login.error: Something went wrong. Check the connection and try again.
login.otpSendFailed: The code could not be sent to your e-mail. Ask the manager to check your e-mail address.
login.codeTitle: Enter the code from your e-mail
login.codeLead: We sent a six-digit code to {{email}}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
login.codeSample: Sample mode: any six digits work.
login.codeOrLink: The e-mail comes from Muhazi Medical Clinic Ltd with the subject "… is your sign-in code". It is valid for 10 minutes. Not there after a minute? Look in Spam or Promotions, or send a new code.
login.codeWrong: Wrong code. Check your e-mail and try again.
login.codeExpired: This code has expired. Send a new one.
login.codeResent: A new code is on its way.
login.linkMismatch: That sign-in link belongs to {{got}}, not {{expected}}. Nobody was signed in. Open the newest e-mail sent to {{expected}}, or sign in again.
login.trustHint: Next time on this browser, your staff ID, username and PIN are enough — no e-mailed code until the trust expires. Untick on a shared computer.

register.title: Register a patient
register.lead: First visit or returning patient. Normally the patient goes to triage first for vitals; in an emergency the patient stays with you and you register the file right here.
register.emergency: Emergency — the patient is treated here, not at triage
register.emergencyHint: The patient is queued at your station with red priority. Register the file now or as soon as the patient is stable.
register.triageHint: The patient receives a ticket and goes to triage for the first measurements.
register.searchLabel: Find by name, file number, phone or national ID
register.noMatch: No patient found. Register a new file on the right.

done.title: Patient registered
done.triageNote: Ticket issued. The patient goes to triage for vitals, then to the right station.
done.emergencyNote: Emergency: the patient is first in the {{station}} queue.
done.where: The patient is saved in the patient register. Their visit is open and queued at triage (nurse station), where vitals are taken before the doctor.

errors.openVisit: This patient already has an open visit.

noId.label: National ID
noId.childHint: For a child, put the parent’s or guardian’s phone number and their name as the emergency contact in the file.

triage.title: Triage · first measurements
triage.lead: Every patient passes here first (MoH workflow). Take the vitals, choose the triage colour and send the patient to the right station.
triage.select: Select a patient on the left to record the vitals.
triage.readOnly: Only nurses and doctors record vitals.

prices.title: Treatments, prices and insurers
prices.lead: Everything the clinic treats, with its price and the discount a clinician may give without asking you. Insurers you work with get their own prices and coverage.

form.categoryNone: Not shown on the public site
form.maxDiscount: Largest discount a clinician may give
form.insurerPrices: Insurer prices (leave empty to use the cash price)
form.allowManual: Clinician may type a different price (with a reason)
form.suggested: Kinyarwanda and French names were suggested from the English one. Correct them if they are not what you mean.
form.maxDiscountNone: Only the manager can give a discount on this treatment.
form.allowManualHint: For treatments whose cost varies, such as a surgery or a long dressing. At the visit screen the clinician can enter another price instead of the list price, and must say why. The manager can always do this.
form.activeHint: Untick to hide the treatment from the visit screen without deleting it, e.g. while a machine is broken. Its history stays.

insurers.title: Insurers and coverage
insurers.lead: The insurers the clinic works with and what each covers. Per-group percentages override the overall one (for example dental 50%). Only active insurers can be chosen on a visit.

form.name: Name
form.byGroup: Coverage per group (optional, overrides the overall %)
form.active: Active — the clinic works with this insurer
form.publicNote: The public site keeps its "insurance coming soon" band until FEATURES.insurance is switched on in the code.

insurers.parked: Insurers are switched off: the clinic does not work with an insurer yet, so all patients pay cash or mobile money. Insurer prices and coverage will appear here when the first partnership starts.
insurers.confirmDelete: Delete the insurer "{{name}}"? Past bills keep it.

errors.name: A name is required.
errors.price: The price must be a whole number of francs, zero or more.
errors.discount: The discount must be 0–100 %, at most the price in RWF, or a multiplier between 0 and 1.
errors.coverage: Coverage is a percentage between 0 and 100.

prices.show: Show at the visit screen again
prices.confirmDelete: Delete "{{name}}"? It disappears from every list. Bills that already used it keep it.
prices.hidden: "{{name}}" is hidden: clinicians can no longer charge it.
prices.maxDiscountTitle: The largest discount a clinician may give on this treatment

adjust.title: Adjust many prices at once
adjust.lead: Raise or lower the cash price of every treatment, or of one group, in one step. Treatments that are free stay free.
adjust.invalid: Enter a valid number for this kind of change.
adjust.confirm: Change the price of {{count}} treatments now?

prices.leadCash: Everything the clinic treats, its price, and the discount a clinician may give without asking you. Search, duplicate, hide, delete, or change many prices at once.

visit.notFound: This visit was not found or is already closed.

payer.title: Who pays
payer.label: Payer
payer.hint: Choosing an insurer re-splits every charge on this bill using its coverage.
payer.noInsurers: No insurer is active yet: the patient pays the full amount at the cashier.

add.title: Add a treatment

errors.discount: The discount is a percentage between 0 and 100.
errors.overMax: You may give up to {{pct}}% on this treatment. Ask the manager for more.
errors.reason: Give the reason for the discount.
errors.noManual: This treatment does not allow a different price. Use a discount, or ask the manager to tick "Clinician may type a different price".

add.adjust: Discount or price change (discount up to {{max}} %)
add.adjustHint: Optional. Type 10 for 10 %, switch to RWF for an amount, or × for a multiplier.
add.newPrice: New price {{price}} per unit (needs a reason)

payment.title: Payment
payment.nothingYet: Nothing has been charged on this visit yet.

errors.tooMuch: The amount exceeds the balance due ({{balance}}).
errors.reference: A transaction reference is required for this method.

next.title: Done at this station
next.lead: Closes the {{station}} queue entry and sends the patient on.
next.anyDoctorHint: The patient waits at {{desks}} at once; the first doctor who is free takes the patient and the others no longer see them.
next.pick: Or choose one or more desks
next.manyHint: Several desks: the patient waits at each one and leaves the others as soon as one desk takes them.

visit.sentMany: Patient sent to {{station}}: the first one free takes the patient.

settings.title: Clinic settings
settings.lead: You run the whole clinic from here: the public identity and contacts, the opening hours that drive the "open now" status and the booking calendar, and shortcuts to every station.

profile.title: Clinic identity and contacts
profile.lead: Shown on the public site, receipts and messages. Changes are visible immediately.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.lead: Per day: open 24 hours, custom hours or closed. The laboratory has its own hours.

settings.savedNote: Saved. The public site shows the new values.

patientFields.title: Patient file fields
patientFields.lead: Add the information your clinic wants on every patient file beyond the standard fields (religion, chronic condition, next of kin, insurance card number…). Staff fill them in on the patient file.
patientFields.label: Field name
patientFields.saved: Fields saved. They now appear on every patient file.

lock.title: Screen lock
lock.lead: When nobody touches a staff screen for this long, it locks and asks for the PIN. One minute before, a warning appears; any touch or key keeps it open. Locking keeps the page as it was, so no work is lost.
lock.saved: Saved. Every staff screen uses it from now on.

otp.title: E-mailed sign-in code
otp.lead: Codes are sent from the clinic’s Gmail, which allows about 500 e-mails a day. After one correct code a person can trust their device; on that device the staff ID, username and PIN are then enough until the trust expires.
otp.days_one: Once per device, then trusted for {{count}} day
otp.days_other: Once per device, then trusted for {{count}} days
otp.revoked_one: {{count}} device will ask for a code at its next sign-in.
otp.revoked_other: {{count}} devices will ask for a code at their next sign-in.
otp.saved: Saved. It applies from the next sign-in.
otp.hint: Use "Ask every device again" after a phone or computer is lost, or when someone leaves the clinic.

beds.title: Beds and price per night
beds.lead: How many beds the clinic has and what one night costs. Staff see which beds are free, and a stay is billed as nights × this price (or a price agreed for the period).
beds.mixed: The beds have different prices. Type a price to give every bed the same one, or change each bed below.
beds.name: Bed name
beds.occupiedNoRemove: An occupied bed cannot be removed

pin.changeLead: You signed in with the PIN the manager gave you. Replace it with six digits only you know.
pin.mismatch: The two PINs do not match.
pin.same: Choose a PIN different from the current one.
pin.failed: The PIN could not be changed. Check the current PIN and try again.

lock.title: Locked after 5 minutes without activity
lock.body: Enter your PIN to continue as {{name}}.
lock.soon_one: No activity: the screen locks in {{count}} second.
lock.soon_other: No activity: the screen locks in {{count}} seconds.

patients.title: Patients
patients.lead: Every patient the clinic has registered. Open a file to see visits, vitals, diagnoses and bills, update details or start a new visit.
patients.none: No patient matches. Check the spelling or register them.

file.moreLead: Fields the manager added in Settings appear here for every patient. You can also add a one-off field for this patient only.
file.fieldNamePh: e.g. Next of kin, Religion, Insurance card no.
file.noExtra: No extra information yet. Use “Add a field”, or let the manager define fields for every patient in Settings.
file.allergiesHint: Only medicines, foods or substances that cause a reaction (rash, swelling, breathing trouble). Other remarks go in Notes.
file.inClinicNow: This patient is in the clinic now, waiting at {{station}}. The blue button opens that visit: vitals, notes, diagnosis, treatments, prescriptions and payment are all recorded there.

clinical.title: Clinical record
clinical.readOnly: Only doctors, nurses and the manager can write in the clinical record.
clinical.empty: Nothing recorded for this visit yet.
clinical.finishHint: A primary diagnosis is required. If money is still due the patient is sent to the cashier.
clinical.finishConfirm: Close this visit? Open orders stay open; an unpaid bill sends the patient to the cashier.

errors.rx: Choose a medicine and a quantity above zero.
errors.needPrimary: Record a primary diagnosis before closing the visit.

clinical.dxHint: The diagnosis is the disease or problem you found after examining the patient, e.g. “Uncomplicated malaria”. Primary = the main reason for this visit; secondary = other problems found. Tick “provisional” when you are still waiting for results.
clinical.rxHint: One block per medicine. Use “Add another medicine” for a combination (e.g. an antimalarial plus paracetamol). All of them go to the pharmacy together.
clinical.rxSaved_one: Prescription saved. The patient is queued at the pharmacy.
clinical.rxSaved_other: {{count}} medicines prescribed. The patient is queued at the pharmacy.

errors.invalid: That value does not work here. Check the number and the mode (%, RWF, ×).
errors.tooMuch: The discount is more than the price.

visits.title: In the clinic
visits.lead: Every patient with an open visit today, grouped by where they are now. Open a visit to treat, charge or send the patient on; the folder opens the patient file.
visits.none: Nobody is in the clinic right now. Register a patient to start a visit.

desk.arrivalsAria: Patients arriving per hour today, {{count}} in total

receptionist.subtitle: Front desk
receptionist.inquiriesHint: Booking requests from the website or phone. Call back and confirm a time.

nurse.subtitle: Nursing
nurse.urgencyHint: Colours come from triage. Red patients are called first at every station.

vitalsForm.selfHint: You measured now. If you are typing a nurse’s paper sheet, choose her name and the time she wrote.
vitalsForm.paperHint: From the paper sheet: the measurements are saved as taken by this nurse at this time, and as typed in by you.

errors.who: Choose the nurse who took the measurements.
errors.time: Enter the time of the measurement.
errors.future: The measurement time is in the future.

appts.title: Appointments
appts.lead: Booked patients for the day and booking requests to answer.
appts.arrivedHint: The patient is here: opens a visit and queues them at triage for the nurse.
appts.registerFirst: Register the patient first: this booking has no patient file yet.
appts.cancelReason: Why is the appointment of {{name}} cancelled?
appts.flow: How it links up: an approved request waits for the doctor to accept; on the day, "Arrived" opens the visit and the patient appears in the nurse’s triage queue; after the vitals the nurse sends the patient to the doctor.

inquiries.rejectReason: Why is the request from {{name}} rejected? (the person is told)
inquiries.hint: Approve links the request to the patient’s file (matched by phone) and sends it to the doctor to accept.

tasks.whatPh: e.g. Injection: ceftriaxone 1 g IM, repeat vitals
tasks.sent: Sent. It is on the nurses’ dashboard now.

beds.nobody: Nobody in the clinic to admit
beds.confirmDischarge: Discharge {{name}} from this bed? The bed goes to cleaning.
beds.agree: Agree a price for this period
beds.totalAgreed_one: {{count}} night at the agreed price: {{total}} on the bill
beds.totalAgreed_other: {{count}} nights at the agreed price: {{total}} on the bill
beds.hint: The stay goes on the patient’s bill when the patient is put in the bed: nights × the bed’s price, or the price agreed for the period.

files.title: Files to complete
files.completeNow: The file is complete. Send the patient on to the doctor.
files.hint: The nurse registered these patients with what she could. Take the phone, national ID and address, then send the patient to the doctor.
files.sendToReception: Reception will complete the file ({{missing}}) before the doctor.
files.stillMissing: The file still needs {{missing}}: reception can complete it later.
files.sentToDoctor: Sent to consultation. The doctor sees the patient in the queue.
files.nurseHint: Fill in what you know (name, sex, age). Reception completes the phone, national ID and address after your measurements.
files.receptionHint: Fill in everything you can. If the nurse already registered the patient, find them on the left instead of creating a second file.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.inquiryBody: Approve or reject it in Bookings.
notify.toAcceptBody: Reception approved it; accept or decline on your home page.
notify.subject: Title

textSize.title: Text size
textSize.lead: Makes the text, icons and buttons of every staff screen bigger or smaller on this computer.

notices.title: Notifications
notices.lead: Everything addressed to you: patients waiting at your desk, tasks, bookings and messages. Open what a notice is about, mark it read or remove it from your list.
notices.leadManager: Everything addressed to you, and the messages you send to the staff. Filter, open, mark read or remove; in "Sent" you see how many have read each message.
notices.noneSent: You have not sent a message yet.
